title: Client Pipeline Value Stage Concentration
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:lead
| stats sum(pipeline_value_usd) as amount count as records by stage
| eventstats sum(amount) as total_amount
| eval pct_of_total=round(100*amount/total_amount,1)
| sort - pct_of_total
description: Shows how concentrated client pipeline value value is in each stage bucket.
value: Concentration risk matters in personal businesses because too much dependence on one stage can make a quiet month painful.
implementation: Use stable group labels such as client segment, quarter, or service line for consistent trending.
visualization: Treemap or bar chart of amount share by stage.
grandmaExplanation: It produces whether too much of client pipeline value depends on one stage bucket.
